patches.name: Remove crash reporting
patches.summary: Sentry is dead at every layer: native libraries, Java integration, and the JavaScript SDK.

patches.name: Remove telemetry and analytics
patches.summary: Analytics events, metrics, jank reports, NetStats, watchdog traces, and the telemetry ring are stubbed.

patches.name: Disable ad and attribution SDKs
patches.summary: AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, Install Referrer, and the advertising ID are disabled.

patches.name: Close privacy side channels
patches.summary: No address-book read, no installed-app enumeration, no exported Discord RPC service, and dead permissions removed.

patches.name: Block tracking and storefront endpoints
patches.summary: A rebuilt OkHttp interceptor answers analytics, storefront, quest, promotion, and Spotify requests with a local 204.

patches.name: Keep the patched JavaScript bundle
patches.summary: Discord cannot replace the patched Hermes bundle with an over-the-air download.

patches.name: Remove Shop, Quests, Orbs, and Nitro surfaces
patches.summary: Storefront and engagement screens are hidden or nulled, and their entry points stop rendering.

patches.name: Remove the Spotify integration
patches.summary: Spotify calls and track rendering are blocked; a friend's already-cached activity row can still appear.

patches.name: Keep calls alive and responsive
patches.summary: Foreground-service type, call-path overhead, EGL statistics, and camera-log fixes are applied.

patches.name: Reduce startup and background work
patches.summary: Debug logging, logcat capture, resource monitors, and dead startup loads are removed.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.summary: Web links open in your default browser instead of Discord's in-app tab.
patches.notes: Discord already ships the external-browser path. Nothing new runs; the app does not select the in-app tab.

patches.name: Hide remaining promotion surfaces
patches.summary: Hides Nitro upsell pills, the contact-sync prompt, group-chat Nitro banners, picker promotions, and activity previews.
patches.notes: Complements the core Shop/Nitro/Quests removal. Each surface is a separate component and is stubbed independently.

patches.name: Quiet Super Reactions
patches.summary: Stops looping Super Reaction decorations from animating over messages.

patches.name: Hide list dividers
patches.summary: Removes the thin separator lines between settings and other list rows.
patches.notes: Cosmetic. The divider component is replaced with a null renderer; the rows themselves are untouched.

patches.name: Hide your typing indicator
patches.summary: Stops outgoing TYPING events, so other people do not see you typing.
patches.notes: This changes what other people see. It does not hide other people's typing from you.

patches.name: Keep empty DM calls open
patches.summary: Stops Discord from leaving an empty DM call after three minutes.
patches.notes: The idle disconnect still runs on Discord's servers; this only removes the client-side trigger.

patches.name: Static sticker previews
patches.summary: Uses still sticker previews and chat images instead of animated ones.

patches.name: Higher stream quality
patches.summary: Reports the Nitro high and mid stream tiers as available.
patches.notes: Discord can reject the tier on its side. This does not grant an entitlement; it only stops the client from gating the option.

patches.name: Higher video upload quality
patches.summary: Reports the increased video upload quality tier as available. Upload limits are unchanged.
patches.notes: Discord can reject the tier on its side. This does not grant an entitlement.

patches.name: Skip masked link warnings
patches.summary: Opens masked links without Discord's destination warning.
patches.notes: The warning exists to stop phishing. Leave this off unless you accept that risk.

patches.name: Show blocked users' messages
patches.summary: Shows messages from blocked users without unblocking them.

patches.name: Create video surfaces off the main thread
patches.summary: Stops a video tile from freezing the interface while its EGL surface starts.
patches.notes: Pairs the off-thread post with a released-guard, so a tile closed mid-start cannot leak an EGL context.

patches.name: Stop incoming calls freezing the interface
patches.summary: Draws the incoming-call screen immediately instead of waiting on a network avatar fetch.
patches.notes: Costs the caller's avatar on that screen; the name still shows. Keeping the avatar needs a background-thread restructure.

patches.name: Cap the video surface teardown wait
patches.summary: Bounds the UI-thread wait when a video tile closes, so a stuck render thread cannot hang the interface.
patches.notes: Trades ANR risk for a narrow ordering race. Test join, leave, rotate, and backgrounding during a call.

patches.name: Lower video capture resolution
patches.summary: Requests 640x360 at 24 fps instead of 1280x720 at 30 fps.
patches.notes: Do not enable alone: capture and encode share one budget, and lowering capture without the encoder budget crashes the camera on open.

patches.name: React Compiler components
patches.summary: Runs Discord's compiled component variants instead of the uncompiled ones.
patches.notes: Selects a code path Discord has not shipped to users. It also brings back the Wishlist and Board profile tabs.

patches.name: Remove unused translations
patches.summary: Deletes translation catalogs for languages the app never loads, cutting several MB from the download.
patches.notes: Keeps British English. If text is blank or the app fails to start, turn this off and rebuild.

patches.name: Remove the camera frame-rate log
patches.summary: Stops the video engine building a log line every two seconds per camera for a sink nothing reads.
patches.notes: The tag constant used by freeze detection is kept. Removing it previously crashed the camera on open.

patches.name: Quiet the media engine logs
patches.summary: Passes a non-debug log level to the native voice and video engine.
patches.notes: The value is undocumented and is a suspect for the instant camera crash. Leave it off unless testing.
